title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You’re supposed to tell me these things, you’re dead to me
I was at the urologist office when I found out this morning. I apologize
Gotta get an ultrasound in five days and then I’ll know more
Bought you a lot of gum. Don’t get yourself any next time you come home
What is the future of baseball reporting 5-10 years from now
Probably podcasting/audio. A lot of breaking news. I suspect the game story will have morphed into something different if not nonexistent.
